scope: Saved research inputs, results, portable source dependency and selected software evidence; not a new extension package or scientific acceptance.
text_policy: Current docs and browsable reports use portable locators. Runtime assets, numerical inputs and frozen scientific JSON retain original byte identities and may contain inert source provenance paths; no referenced local directories/environments are included. Resource documentation and log copies strip private machine paths. Restore zz-frozen-code-originals.tar.gz last to recover hash-pinned original experiment scripts at their recorded locations. These original scripts may contain inert producer-machine locators; adapt invocation/environment explicitly without changing frozen method identity.
excluded: Recovery/quarantine areas and cleanup/development process records
Duplicate extension ZIPs and installation backups
Material-point F/G original runs absent from workspace
